How scientists learned to control brain cells with light
description:
The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine has been awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for their pioneering discoveries in optogenetics and light-gated ion channels.
 
Their research transformed neuroscience by enabling scientists to control and study specific nerve cells using light, revealing how brain circuits regulate memory, emotions, behaviour and bodily functions. The breakthrough has opened new avenues for understanding neurological and psychiatric disorders and is already influencing research into conditions such as Alzheimer’s disease, addiction and vision loss.

The police stopped their march just before reaching Akashvani Bhavan, leading to a lengthy dharna by the MPs. Despite police attempts to remove the protesters, several MPs entered the Akashvani premises and continued their demonstration. Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi and accused his government of treasonous actions against the country.

title: Astronomers find ‘phoenix planet’ born from ashes of a dying star
description: A team of astronomers has discovered a second-generation planet orbiting a white dwarf named HS 0209+0832. This planet formed from the material that the white dwarf expelled during its death. The atmosphere of the white dwarf contains heavy elements such as zinc, copper, and niobium. This discovery could change the way astronomers search for similar planets around dead stars.

Among the suspects, 13 are reported Navy personnel, and electronic devices have been seized during searches. Two individuals have already been arrested for allegedly leaking sensitive information related to the Indian Navy.

His rebound made him only the second Indian scorer against Uruguay, joining Manas Bhattacharya, who struck in 1982. After its acquisition by Aileen Getty in 2015 for $2.9 million, it is now available for $4.5 million.
